messages:
Alex Kim: hey team, running into a weird TS/edge startup issue in the starter-playground sample after upgrading SDK -> 0.9.x. Edge build fails with overload/generic errors. anyone seen overloads blow up when using unknown vs any in call signatures?

Priya Patel: seen the symptom. often comes down to tsconfig + package type mismatch. starter-playground ships with "module": "ESNext" and "type": "module" in package.json which trips node resolution in some builders. :facepalm:

Jin Park: can you paste the exact error? usually the workaround is module: "nodenext" + moduleResolution: "nodenext" or node16. also try "skipLibCheck": true if it's third-party types.

sam-ci-bot: build log attached
```
> tsc -p tsconfig.json
src/app.ts:45:12 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'unknown' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string | number'.
src/client.ts:12:5 - error TS2769: No overload matches this call. The last overload gave the following error.
```

Alex Kim: exact stack is the SDK's overloads for Client.request<T>(opts) vs Client.request(opts, callback). TS can't infer generic when using unknown in our Response type, so it picks the wrong overload.

Priya Patel: two options: (1) tweak our SDK typings to add a narrower overload that accepts unknown and returns any, (2) fix sample tsconfig so tsc picks the right resolver. For samples I'd prefer making the tsconfig explicit so users aren't blocked.

Jin Park: sample tsconfig I used to unbreak builds:
```
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "nodenext",
    "moduleResolution": "nodenext",
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true
  }
}
```
Also add "type": "module" in package.json and an "exports" map for the CJS interop.

Dana Lee: +1 to updating the sample and leaving a comment in the SDK repo about improving overloads. We should avoid encouraging cast-to-any in quickstarts. I'll volunteer to open the issue and add a minimal repro.

Alex Kim: awesome. action items: Priya will PR a tsconfig patch to starter-playground, Dana will open sdk typings issue with a tiny repro (include the overload signature and the unknown variant), Jin will add a note to the Edge README about node/tooling variance. I'll add a follow-up to onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:

sam-ci-bot: created issue #4567 in repo/starter-playground: "fix tsconfig for edge/ESM CJS interop"
